verification_candidates.claim_text: The more stress a person is under, the more epinephrine, norepinephrine and cortisol their body releases.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The more stress that you're under, the more epinephrine and norepinephrine and cortisol is pumped out.
verification_candidates.rationale: Physiological claim about stress-hormone output that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Ongoing stress eventually leads to adrenal burnout, in which the adrenal glands become too tired to produce enough cortisol, epinephrine and norepinephrine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So this is going to lead to eventually adrenal burnout where your poor adrenal glands are so damn tired, they cannot produce enough cortisol, epinephrine, and norepinephrine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Adrenal fatigue is a contested diagnosis; the causal claim needs checking.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Exhausted adrenal glands cause fatigue, a 'wired but tired' feeling, and weight gain.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So this is where the fatigue comes in or the feeling of being wired but tired.
verification_candidates.rationale: Attributes symptoms and weight gain to a contested adrenal condition.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine supplementation improves mood because it helps the body produce dopamine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So using L-tyrosine, in addition to it literally improving your mood, because it can improve your mood because it helps produce dopamine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Efficacy claim for a supplement on mood that listeners may act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking L-tyrosine provides the building block of stress hormones and makes people more resilient to stress.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It's also you're providing your body with that building block of the stress hormones so that you become more resilient to stress
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement efficacy claim for stress resilience.

verification_candidates.claim_text: High levels of life stress cause weight gain, increased inflammation and disrupted sleep.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: When you're under that amount of stress, weight is gonna come on, inflammation is gonna increase, your sleep is gonna be all jacked up.
verification_candidates.rationale: Causal claim about stress's effects on weight, inflammation and sleep.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When people do not sleep, their insulin regulation is severely disrupted.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And we know when we're not sleeping, our insulin regulation goes off the charts
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable claim on sleep loss and insulin regulation.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stress can raise blood glucose readings to 120 or 180 even when a person has eaten only a steak.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: why am I getting a 120 or a 180 reading on my glucometer? Well, because you're under stress.
verification_candidates.rationale: Causal claim attributing high glucose readings to stress.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Eating chocolate increases dopamine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: even eating chocolate increases your dopamine
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable neurochemical claim about a common food.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine helps raise dopamine so that people come out of depressed, low-mood states with more energy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Well, L-tyrosine actually helps with that. So when we come out of that deep depressed state, when we come out of that low mood state, we have more energy.
verification_candidates.rationale: Implies a supplement treats depressed mood, which could affect treatment choices.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine increases energy by supporting thyroid function and the production of dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: L-tyrosine can also increase energy by supporting thyroid function and the production of dopamine, norepinephrine, epinephrine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement efficacy and mechanism claim involving thyroid function.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine's effects on mood, adrenals, thyroid hormone production and energy help with weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: all of that can stack upon itself and help with weight.
verification_candidates.rationale: Weight-loss claim for a supplement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Forskolin, a compound in coleus forskohlii, has been studied for decades for its effects on weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it contains a bioactive compound called forscolin, which this has been studied for decades, decades, for its effects on weight loss.
verification_candidates.rationale: Appeal to a research record that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Forskolin activates the enzyme adenylate cyclase, which increases levels of cyclic AMP in cells.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Horsicolin activates an enzyme called adenylate cyclase.
verification_candidates.rationale: Mechanistic claim underpinning a weight-loss pitch.

verification_candidates.claim_text: By raising cAMP, forskolin increases lipolysis and reduces fat accumulation, helping with weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it can increase lipolysis or the breakdown of fats and reduce fat accumulation, making it easier to lose fat
verification_candidates.rationale: Weight-loss efficacy claim for an herbal supplement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: It takes 3,500 calories to equal one pound of fat.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Because we know it takes 3,500 calories to equal one pound.
verification_candidates.rationale: Widely repeated energy-balance rule that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In a hypothyroid state a person's basal metabolic rate may fall to around 500 calories a day.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your basal metabolic rate is in the toilet. Maybe it's down to 500 calories a day.
verification_candidates.rationale: Quantitative claim about metabolic rate in hypothyroidism.

certainty_markers: it is possible that you could
verification_candidates.claim_text: A person with a thyroid problem, insulin resistance and a low metabolism could put on five pounds of fat in two days.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Yeah, it is possible that you could put on five pounds in two days
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about rate of fat gain that contradicts energy-balance expectations.
